name: WGISD: Wine Grape Instance Segmentation Dataset
description: The Wine Grape Instance Segmentation Dataset (WGISD) is an open agricultural image collection curated by Embrapa Digital Agriculture and the University of Campinas (UNICAMP) in Brazil, published in BioData Mining. The dataset consists of 300 high-resolution field photographs captured in commercial Brazilian vineyards across five distinct wine grape varieties (Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Merlot, and Sauvignon Blanc). Annotations document 4,432 grape bunches with precise bounding boxes, instance segmentation polygon masks, and individual berry point annotations, serving as a benchmark for automated cluster detection, robotic harvesting, and in-field viticultural yield estimation.
